platform: Windows, Rust release/mimalloc, Vite production, headless Chromium

notes.frontend_baseline: Workspace source snapshot restoring pre-round algorithms while preserving concurrent UI changes; 2 Vite overrides. Baseline snapshot SHA256 recorded.
notes.stages: round4-before/after-frontend: initial index changes; final-before/after: stable virtual keys; accepted and reverse: final code with row reuse and combined navigation pass. Keep intermediate samples for traceability.
notes.pipeline_interference: First baseline startup overlapped a browser regression run; reverse pipeline runs have no concurrent agent-launched CPU work.
notes.timing: UI edit latency includes Playwright and two animation frames, excludes backend IO; engine timing includes internal drops, excludes returned output drop. Small sample sets do not establish stable edit P95.
notes.validation: 730 Rust tests, 359 frontend unit tests, 33 browser interactions; full reload equivalence and edited-value verification passed.
notes.backend_stages: Initial round4 and ABBA runs precede the consuming-iterator cleanup restoring early release of owned inputs. Final-owned runs use the final source. Earlier binary hash preserved as pre-lifetime.
